relevant_files.purpose: Fetches the QiangZhi timetable page via synchronous XHR GET and strips CR/LF before handing to the parser

Parses the xskb_list.do HTML: section time table (regexT), course cells (.kbcontent hidden div, day from div id), teacher/weeks/sections/room inner fields (regexS), week range/comma expansion, section range expansion, red-P course-name marker cleanup

protocol_approach: XiaoAi course-table adapter for 沈阳工业大学 (Shenyang University of Technology) 强智教务. Provider does a synchronous GET of the relative path /jsxsd/xskb/xskb_list.do and returns responseText with CR/LF stripped. The parser scans the HTML with regexes (jQuery-style DOM parsing suggested but not used): a time-table regex extracts per-section start/end times (45-minute heuristic to derive the missing half of each pair), and a cell regex matches kbcontent1 followed by the display:none class="kbcontent" div whose id encodes the weekday, then an inner regex splits each cell into course name, teacher, weeks(周), sections(节), and room. Weeks are comma-separated tokens each expanded from N or N-M ranges; sections likewise from [N-M节].
verdict_reason: Same QiangZhi protocol family parsing: identical /jsxsd/xskb/xskb_list.do endpoint, parses the hidden class="kbcontent" cell div with weekday encoded in the div id, and expands comma/range week tokens and [N-M节] section tokens exactly like Sleepy; the only gap is this repo implements no 单周/双周 (odd/even) week logic, so it does not corroborate that sub-semantics.

sleepy_claim_check.强智 xskb_list.do + kbcontent 解析形态: match — endpoint /jsxsd/xskb/xskb_list.do identical, class="kbcontent" (display:none) cell div parsing identical, day/section/week coordinate semantics same family (day from div id segment, weeks as comma-separated N / N-M tokens, sections from [N-M节]); differs only in that this repo has no 单周(odd)/双周(even) handling
